definitions.explanation: the act of reporting someone's wrongdoing to a person in authority, often with negative connotations

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{告|つ}げ{口|ぐち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To tell on someone to the teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{告|つ}げ{口|ぐち}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧わからない⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧バレてしまった。
examples.english: I don't know who snitched, but my secret got out.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{告|つ}げる→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧ (to tell, inform) + {口|ぐち} (mouth, speech)

USAGE:
This word has a childish or petty connotation. It implies reporting someone's minor misdeeds rather than serious wrongdoing.

FORMS:
{告|つ}げ{口|ぐち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / {告|つ}げ{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to tattle, to snitch

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{密告|みっこく}→密告：18033_mikkoku⟧ - informing, reporting (more formal/serious)
- チクる - to snitch (slang)
- ⟦{言|い}いつける→言いつける：21618_iitsukeru⟧ - to tell on someone
